title: Pontotoc County gas averages $3.50 a gallon heading into Thanksgiving week
excerpt: AAA’s Saturday figures put Pontotoc about 10 cents above the state average. Regular gas in neighboring Union County averaged $3.35.
locality: Pontotoc County and neighboring counties in northeast Mississippi.

paragraphs.text: Regular gasoline averaged $3.50 a gallon in Pontotoc County on Saturday, about 10 cents above Mississippi’s $3.40 average as Thanksgiving week approached. For a 15-gallon fill-up, the difference between those two averages comes to about $1.50.

Among neighboring counties, Union averaged $3.35 and Lee $3.49. Prices were higher in Lafayette County at $3.55 and Chickasaw County at $3.58. The spread between Union and Chickasaw came to about $3.50 on 15 gallons, using county averages. Individual stations can charge more or less.

Mississippi’s average fell roughly 16 cents in a week and 48 cents in a month. Even with those declines, a gallon still cost about 79 cents more than at this time last year, when the state average was $2.61. Those comparisons use the statewide series.

Nationally, AAA’s average was $3.66 Saturday, down from $3.72 in its Thursday report. At Saturday’s prices, regular gas in Pontotoc County averaged about 16 cents less per gallon than it did nationwide.
